levels.1: Replays, discoveries, guided opportunities, and varied challenge methods all feed the same destination progression.

levels.2: Raise this destination's Mastery to rank 20; the Challenges tab supplies the XP needed for every gated reward.

areas.name: New York Bank
areas.location_cue: A multilevel bank with a public hall, offices, vault spaces, security rooms, and a basement garage.
areas.note: All ordinary assignment challenges can be replayed. Use the destination Challenges panel to verify registration before moving to another location.

levels.1: Replays, discoveries, guided opportunities, and varied challenge methods all feed the same destination progression.
levels.2: Raise this destination's Mastery to rank 20; the Challenges tab supplies the XP needed for every gated reward.
levels.3: Complete high-value challenges first, then use unclaimed discoveries and simple feats to fill the remaining XP. Reach rank 20 and verify every reward in the Career mastery panel. Unlock schedule: At rank 1, claim Bank Entrance as a Starting Location reward; At rank 2, claim Small Goldbar as a Melee reward; At rank 3, claim First Floor Mezzanine as a Starting Location reward; At rank 4, claim Waiting Area Bathroom as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 5, claim ICA Remote Flash Device as a Explosive reward; At rank 6, claim First Floor Janitor Room as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 7, claim Audit Hall as a Starting Location reward; At rank 8, claim Second Floor Bathroom as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 10, claim Deposit Box as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 12, claim Deposit Box Room as a Starting Location reward; At rank 13, claim Sawed Off Bartoli 12G as a Shotgun reward; At rank 14, claim Investment Floor as a Starting Location reward; At rank 16, claim Executive Floor as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 17, claim Garage as a Starting Location reward; At rank 18, claim Vault Loading Bay as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 20, claim Challenge as a Golden Sawed Off Bartoli 12G reward; At rank 20, claim The New Yorker with Gloves as a Coat reward.

areas.name: Dubai Tower
areas.location_cue: A glass-and-gold tower interior with an atrium, exhibition floors, staff passages, terraces, and upper suites.
areas.note: All ordinary assignment challenges can be replayed. Use the destination Challenges panel to verify registration before moving to another location.

levels.1: Replays, discoveries, guided opportunities, and varied challenge methods all feed the same destination progression.
levels.2: Raise this destination's Mastery to rank 20; the Challenges tab supplies the XP needed for every gated reward.
levels.3: Complete high-value challenges first, then use unclaimed discoveries and simple feats to fill the remaining XP. Reach rank 20 and verify every reward in the Career mastery panel. Unlock schedule: At rank 2, claim Atrium Lobby as a Starting Location reward; At rank 2, claim Burj Al-Ghazali Snowglobe as a Melee reward; At rank 3, claim Kitchen as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 4, claim Meeting Room as a Starting Location reward; At rank 5, claim Emetic Poison Vial as a Poison reward; At rank 6, claim Penthouse Supply Room as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 7, claim ICA Briefcase MK III as a Container reward; At rank 7, claim Art Installation as a Starting Location reward; At rank 8, claim Atrium Toilet as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 9, claim Maintenance Room as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 10, claim Explosive Golf Ball as a Explosive reward; At rank 11, claim Guard Room as a Starting Location reward; At rank 12, claim Laundry Room as a Hidden Stash reward; At rank 13, claim Ornate Scimitar as a Melee reward; At rank 14, claim Art Backstage Balcony as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 15, claim Druzhina 34 DTI as a Sniper Rifle reward; At rank 17, claim Penthouse Ventilation Area as a Agency Pickup reward; At rank 19, claim Penthouse as a Starting Location reward; At rank 20, claim Challenge as a Trendy Tourist Suit reward; At rank 20, claim Challenge as a RFID Triggered Taser reward; At rank 20, claim ICA Proximity Explosive Mk III as a Explosive reward; At rank 20, claim Ashen Suit With Gloves as a Classic Suit reward.

levels.2: Use Arcade for its own permanent challenge and unlock catalogue; it does not substitute for normal live-window location or milestone rewards.

areas.name: Freelancer Safehouse
areas.location_cue: The lakeside safehouse hub with planning screens, weapon walls, tool cases, and unlockable rooms.
areas.note: Freelancer uses online autosaves and real loss rules. A local file copy cannot reliably reverse server progression, so the safest backup is equipment discipline before departure.

save_backup.title: Protect rare equipment before departure
save_backup.why: A failed showdown, alerted territory, or Hardcore objective can end the campaign and remove carried gear or Freelancer tools.
save_backup.detail: Leave irreplaceable wall weapons at the safehouse unless the objective truly needs them; server-side losses may not be recoverable from a copied PC save.

point_of_no_return.title: Campaign-loss checkpoint ahead
point_of_no_return.why: Launching a territory commits the selected carried gear to Freelancer's loss rules, and activating Prestige deliberately resets named resources.
point_of_no_return.detail: Review the loadout and the Prestige confirmation screen before committing; local save restoration is not a dependable undo for online progression.

levels.1: Build a reliable wall of equipment and choose syndicates whose objectives suit your strongest destinations.
levels.2: Finish all four syndicates in one campaign, including each showdown, without failing an alerted territory.
levels.3: Choose a syndicate type with manageable optional objectives, bring only gear you can afford to lose, identify showdown suspects from the listed tells, eliminate the leader, and exit. Repeat through all four syndicates. A failed showdown or alerted territory ends the campaign and removes carried gear plus Freelancer tools, so preserve rare wall weapons unless needed.

levels.1: Do not enable the harder ruleset until the weapon walls and tool cases can support repeated mandatory objectives.
levels.2: Activate Hardcore Mode at the safehouse only after banking strong gear, then finish a full campaign while completing every mandatory prestige objective.
levels.3: Fill the weapon walls and tool cases first, choose the least risky prestige objective before each departure, and treat every territory as alerted. In a showdown, satisfy the prestige condition as well as the leader objective before exiting. Failure ends the campaign and causes the mode's stated inventory losses; return to normal mode only after the completion record registers.

levels.1: Campaign actions, objectives, couriers, safes, and challenge milestones steadily expand the safehouse.
levels.2: Raise Freelancer Mastery to rank 100 and inspect each newly opened safehouse room, capacity increase, and cosmetic slot.
levels.3: Finish campaigns, prioritize feasible payout and prestige objectives, open safes, and collect courier Merces to maintain steady XP. Continue to rank 100; after each unlock banner, return to the safehouse and interact with every new room, furnishing slot, wardrobe option, gear-capacity increase, and weapon-wall position.

levels.1: Bring recoverable weapons home instead of abandoning useful models at an exit.
levels.2: Fill every weapon silhouette shown on the safehouse walls by extracting with missing firearms and melee weapons or buying them from suppliers.
levels.3: Before a mission, photograph or note empty silhouettes. In the territory, inspect supplier stock and carried weapons, take missing models, and physically exit while holding or packing them. A wall weapon survives at the safehouse only after a successful exit; losing a mission while carrying it removes it until reacquired.

levels.1: Suppliers, reward crates, and successful returns gradually fill the disposable tool cases.
levels.2: Collect every Freelancer tool displayed in the safehouse cases; buy or select missing tools and return successfully.
levels.3: Compare supplier stock and reward-crate choices against empty case slots, acquire a missing tool, then exit the territory safely. save_backup.title: One-attempt server state ahead

save_backup.detail: A copied PC save is not a reliable recovery method. Research the briefing before launch and treat active attempts as irreversible.

point_of_no_return.title: Live attempt becomes locked

point_of_no_return.detail: Do not launch casually. Arcade trials are the replayable alternative but grant a different reward set.
